page_title: BRA 1-0 SWI | Brazil v Switzerland 28/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Rodrygo (Brazil).

90+6' Gabriel Jesus (Brazil) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brazil will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+5' Antony (Brazil) works the corner short.
90+4' Rodrygo (Brazil) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Brazil have been awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90+3' Renato Steffen (Switzerland) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
90+1' The attendance is 43649.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Alex Telles (Brazil) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
88' Nico Elvedi (Switzerland) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ivan Barton blows his whistle for a foul. Brazil win a free kick.
87' Rodrygo (Brazil) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

87' Rodrygo (Brazil) produces a good strike towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. Corner kick. Brazil will have an opportunity.
86' Tite has decided to substitute Alex Sandro and he is replaced by Alex Telles (Brazil).
86' Here comes a substitution. Fabian Frei (Switzerland) is brought on as a substitute for Silvan Widmer.
83' 1 - 0 Goal! Rodrygo plays it to Casemiro (Brazil), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Yann Sommer. 1:0.
82' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) failed to beat the keeper. Yann Sommer expertly stopped his header from the edge of the box which he sent to the middle of the goal after a rebound.
81' The resulting corner from Antony (Brazil) is cleared by the defence.
80' Edimilson Fernandes (Switzerland) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
79' Ricardo Rodriguez (Switzerland) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Ivan Barton blows for a foul.
76' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Rodrygo (Brazil) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
76' Substitution. Breel Embolo walks off the pitch and Haris Seferovic (Switzerland) comes on as a substitute.
76' Murat Yakin prepares a substitution. Djibril Sow is replaced by Michel Aebischer (Switzerland).

75' Silvan Widmer (Switzerland) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Ivan Barton blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
73' The manager makes a subsitution with Antony (Brazil) coming on for Raphinha.
73' Tite decides to make a substitution. Richarlison will be replaced by Gabriel Jesus (Brazil).
72' Richarlison (Brazil) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
70' Raphinha (Brazil) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger.
69' Ivan Barton blows his whistle. Manuel Akanji (Switzerland) commits a foul after dangerous play. Brazil earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
66' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Brazil players look gutted.
66' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Brazil players aren’t happy.
64' Goal! Casemiro slips a clever pass through to Vinicius Junior (Brazil), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
62' Raphinha (Brazil) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
61' Ivan Barton interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Manuel Akanji (Switzerland).
60' Edimilson Fernandes (Switzerland) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Renato Steffen (Switzerland) replaces Fabian Rieder.
58' Murat Yakin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Edimilson Fernandes (Switzerland) replacing Ruben Vargas.
58' Substitution. Fred will be replaced by Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil).
57' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Richarlison.
55' Alex Sandro (Brazil) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
54' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) launches a cross from the corner, but Alisson is alert to thwart the effort.
54' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Good work from Switzerland as they win a corner.

53' Silvan Widmer (Switzerland) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
52' Ivan Barton shows a yellow card to Fred (Brazil) for his blatant foul.
51' Raphinha (Brazil) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
50' It must be a yellow card. It is. Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
48' Ivan Barton blows for a foul after Eder Militao (Brazil) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
47' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) is caught offside!
46' Half-time substitution. Tite decided to make a change. Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) is replaced by Rodrygo.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
45+1' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Switzerland.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Raphinha (Brazil) sends the corner into the box, but Yann Sommer intercepts it and averts the threat.

44' Raphinha (Brazil) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Brazil are awarded a corner kick.
42' Raphinha (Brazil) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Brazil will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
42' Manuel Akanji (Switzerland) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
41' Raphinha (Brazil) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
39' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
38' Half-chance! Raphinha (Brazil) plays a pass into the box, but Yann Sommer reacts well to snuff out the attack.
38' Raphinha (Brazil) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
37' Eder Militao (Brazil) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Brazil force their opponents to concede a corner.
34' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
33' Brazil are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
31' Raphinha (Brazil) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Yann Sommer makes a comfortable save.

29' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ivan Barton with no other option than to blow for a foul.
28' Raphinha (Brazil) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

27' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the left side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Yann Sommer with a brilliant diving save! Brazil force a corner. They send men into the box.
26' Remo Freuler (Switzerland) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
23' Poor challenge! Thiago Silva (Brazil) is penalised for tripping and Ivan Barton blows his whistle.
21' A pass from Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) is intercepted by Alisson and the move breaks down.
20' Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
19' Brazil continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
17' Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Ivan Barton blows his whistle for an infringement.
15' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
15' Casemiro (Brazil) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Switzerland earn a free kick.
14' Alex Sandro (Brazil) makes a rough challenge and Ivan Barton blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Richarlison (Brazil) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
11' The ball is cleared after Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
8' Ricardo Rodriguez (Switzerland) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
6' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Brazil will have a goal kick.

6' Ricardo Rodriguez (Switzerland) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Switzerland will have a chance to score from a corner.
5' Casemiro (Brazil) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
4' Raphinha (Brazil) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
3' Silvan Widmer (Switzerland) commits a rough foul. Ivan Barton stops the game and makes a call. Brazil win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
1' Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
